content_preview:
version: "2026-03-26"
description: "知识操作系统 - 四层记忆架构"

# 4.1 知识分层架构
knowledge_layers:
  l1_core:
    name: "Core"
    storage: "memory/MEMORY.md"
    max_size: "5KB"
    retention: "permanent"
    content_types:
      - 身份定义
      - 用户信息
      - 当前任务上下文
      - 关键决策
      - 信任积分
    update_frequency: "on_change"
    
  l2_working:
    name: "Working"
    storage: "memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md"
    max_size: "50KB"
    retention: "30_days"
    content_types:
      - 当日操作日志
      - 进行中任务
      - 临时决策
